title: Walter Gilman (Chapter 6)
wikitext: [[Image:Walter_ally_chapter_6.png|right|160px]] '''Walter Gilman (Chapter 6)''' is a special [[ally]] used in [[Goodbye, Mr. Whateley|scenario 6]] of the 1st Arkham Spanish League. ==Card info== *+1 [[Focus]] *+1 [[Lore]] The Investigator that has Walter Gilman as an ally receives one additional Madness card each time he/she needs to draw one. ==Notes== This is one of multiple versions of the Walter Gilman ally used by different scenarios.
